purpose: Skill chaining policy. Start with the primary skill, then load only the listed skills that match the task evidence.

rules: Use frontend/UI skills when landing, login, signup, onboarding, app dashboard, responsive behavior, or visual polish are present.
Use payment skills only when a provider or billing workflow is present.
Use Supabase RLS when database, tenancy, auth, policies, or browser-side data access are present.
Use security scan/hooks before production or when the user asks for audit, hardening, or SaaS security.
DAST requires explicit owned target or staging authorization.
Hooks require explicit local repository authorization.
Use only when workstreams are independent or the user explicitly asks for subagents/multiagents.
Assign file/module ownership before implementation agents edit files.
Keep integration and final verification with the lead agent.
Use AionUi as coordination UI, not as the source of truth.
Do not enable YOLO/full-auto for risky code, secrets, payments, auth, production, RLS, migrations, cron, or customer data.
Keep Codex as default executor unless the user explicitly chooses another agent.
Interpret natural-language design requests before selecting a focused intervention.
Load at most two downstream frontend skills for a standard task unless the user requests a deep audit.
Use the external Impeccable CLI only when it is already available or the user explicitly authorizes installation.
Capture one-line intent before classifying scope.
Keep the default analysis read-only: do not edit, revert, stage, commit or push.
Recommend keep, split or justify with evidence from the diff.
Use one-shot verification by default; persistent mode requires an explicit request.
Use web research for unstable or current claims and cite the supporting sources.
Never invent citations or claim verification without evidence.
Keep the work defensive, authorized and read-only by default.
Do not perform active exploitation or broaden the target scope.
Use incremental mode only when a baseline is available.
Inspect the existing router, aliases, manifest and chains before creating a new pattern.
Keep the skill focused and validate natural-language routing with examples.
Do not install an external artifact without a quality and permission review.
Use when the user asks about WhatsApp campaigns for leads in Meta Ads.
Combine with Evolution API skill for WhatsApp API integration.
Combine with billing skill for payment collection via WhatsApp.

mandatoryPreCode.purpose: Architecture First Gate. When SKILLS_ROUTER.riskClasses classifies the change as structural, integration, security-compliance, or domain-critical, run this chain before editing code.
order: deep-interview: resolve intent, Non-goals, and Decision Boundaries below the ambiguity threshold.
skill-preflight: bound scope, impact, failure modes, ownership, and a minimal verification plan.
skill-adr: record the decision, drivers, alternatives, and consequences before implementation.
